title: ISRAELI KNESSET ELECTIONS 2013: will Naftali Bennett emerge as the biggest winner?
description: Israel's election campaign has entered the final stretch with the beginning of a two-week period of televised political advertisements leading up to the January 22 vote. TV ads dominate election coverage in many parts of the world and the only recognized democracy in the Middle East is no different. However this election is different than previous ballots in the Jewish state with social media playing a much larger role.
